# The Hackett Group® – As Seen on CNBC


The Hackett Group® is a leader in generative AI solutions – from ideation through implementation. With our successful introduction of Hackett AI XPLR™ and acquisition of LeewayHertz – a leading multi-agent orchestration firm – we are redefining Digital World Class® performance. We can dynamically identify, evaluate, build and deploy your Gen AI solutions across your enterprise, accelerating your Gen AI journey. The Hackett Group® – from idea to impact.
